responsibility: This is the top-level machine description for the AArch64 backend. It defines the register file numbering, UNSPEC code enums, and the core RTL instruction patterns for scalar AArch64 features such as arithmetic, control flow, system, security, memory-tagging, RNG, LS64, and transactional-memory instructions, and it includes the subsidiary machine-description fragments for AdvSIMD, atomics, load/store-pair peepholes, SVE, and SVE2 so that the backend’s complete RTL-to-assembly mapping is assembled in one place.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem aarch64 files, this is the machine-description source for RTL patterns, register-number constants, and UNSPEC enumerations, including other .md fragments for SIMD, atomics, SVE, and SVE2. It is distinct from aarch64.cc's C++ hook implementation, aarch64.h's target macros and declarations, and aarch64.opt's option definitions.
